name: pi-sandbox
description: OS-level sandboxing for pi with interactive permission prompts
author: Chris Arderne <chris@rdrn.me>

scripts.fmt: ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt index.ts diagnostics.ts sandbox-command.ts diagnostics.test.ts sandbox-command.test.ts browser-process.test.ts
scripts.lint: ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint index.ts diagnostics.ts sandbox-command.ts diagnostics.test.ts sandbox-command.test.ts browser-process.test.ts
scripts.all: npm run fmt && npm run lint && npm run check && npm run test
scripts.ci:fmt: ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check index.ts diagnostics.ts sandbox-command.ts diagnostics.test.ts sandbox-command.test.ts browser-process.test.ts
